mechanism_claims.claim_text: CIGB-552 and related L-2/L-20 peptides are supported as COMMD1-interacting antitumor peptides; CIGB-552 shows stronger COMMD1 pull-down context than L-2/L-20 in H460 cells.
direct_assay_types: biotinylated peptide pull-down followed by COMMD1 Western blot for L-2/L-20/CIGB-552

mechanism_claims.limitations: The direct interaction evidence is cancer-cell/COMMD1 mechanism evidence, not antimicrobial mechanism evidence.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: CIGB-552 in H460 lung cancer cells
mechanism_claims.claim_text: CIGB-552 is source-supported to increase COMMD1, promote RelA ubiquitination/proteasomal degradation, reduce antiapoptotic signaling, and increase apoptosis markers in H460 cells; COMMD1 knockdown reduces this effect.
